body:
## Summary

Every new issue in this repository should get a draft attempt from Formal AI within minutes of being opened, in a branch nobody depends on, so that a wrong attempt costs nothing and a right one saves the first commit. A draft that fails is not waste: it fails in public, with its session evidence attached, and that failure is the input the next improvement to the meta algorithm is made from. Fail fast to learn fast.

This asks Hive Mind to install the reusable action formal-ai is publishing for exactly this, and to point it at `issues: opened`.

## What formal-ai provides

`link-assistant/formal-ai` drives the chain **GitHub Actions -> Hive Mind -> Agent CLI -> Formal AI** in `.github/workflows/self-authored-pull-request.yml`. It takes a task issue, opens a draft pull request under `github-actions[bot]` first so the authored commit can name it, drives the pinned Agent CLI against a `formal-ai serve`, and pushes one commit carrying `Formal-AI-Session`, `Formal-AI-Model`, `Formal-AI-Evidence` and `Formal-AI-Pull-Request` with its evidence bundle. No human commit goes on that branch.

That workflow is being repackaged as a composite action installable from another repository: the scripts ship with the action, Formal AI comes from a release binary or container instead of a source build, and the task contract is an input rather than a repository-relative constant. The formal-ai side of this is tracked in link-assistant/formal-ai#1085.

## What this issue asks of Hive Mind

1. Install the action once it is published, triggered on `issues: opened` rather than on a curated label, so every new issue gets an attempt.
2. Point the model at Hive Mind's own `solve --tool agent --model formal-ai --attach-logs --verbose` path now that #2229 is fixed and the trailers and evidence bundle land on the commit (#2230, v2.24.0). The drafts then measure the same chain Hive Mind ships.
3. Decide the failure policy for a draft: it stays open and red until a later run succeeds, and it is never hand-corrected and merged. A poor draft is closed and the defect filed against the meta algorithm, not patched on the branch.

## Why here first

Hive Mind opens more issues than formal-ai and its issues are the ones read most often, so it is where the volume of evidence per day is highest. The drafts are also a continuous, unfaked measurement of whether `solve --model formal-ai` is getting better at real tasks in the repository that owns `solve`.

## Done when

- A new issue in this repository produces a draft pull request authored by Formal AI, with the four trailers and the evidence bundle on its commit, and no human commit on its branch.
- A draft that fails leaves its session log attached (`--attach-logs --verbose`), so the cause is readable after the container is gone.
title: Open a Formal AI draft for every new issue: install the reusable authoring action on issues: opened
